essays.title: 养老机器人

paragraphs.label: 第1段
outline: 图表清楚显示，消费者对养老机器人持有不同的态度。
39.3%的受访者完全接受，32.8%部分接受，27.9%不接受。
在主要关注点方面，46.3%关注安全，24.9%关注价格，10.7%关注便利性。
总体而言，超过70%的受访者至少部分接受养老机器人，而安全是他们最关心的问题。

sentences.text: As is clearly shown in the charts, consumers have different attitudes toward elderly-care robots.
sentences.chinesePrompt: 图表清楚显示，消费者对养老机器人持有不同的态度。

sentences.text: 39.3% of the respondents fully accept them, 32.8% partly accept them, and 27.9% do not accept them.
sentences.chinesePrompt: 39.3%的受访者完全接受，32.8%部分接受，27.9%不接受。

sentences.text: As for their main concerns, 46.3% pay attention to safety, 24.9% focus on price, and 10.7% care about convenience.
sentences.chinesePrompt: 在主要关注点方面，46.3%关注安全，24.9%关注价格，10.7%关注便利性。

sentences.text: In general, more than 70% of the respondents at least partly accept elderly-care robots, and safety is their greatest concern.
sentences.chinesePrompt: 总体而言，超过70%的受访者至少部分接受养老机器人，而安全是他们最关心的问题。

paragraphs.label: 第2段
outline: 养老机器人受到欢迎有几个原因。
一方面，人口老龄化增加了养老需求，机器人能够帮助减轻家庭和社会的压力。
另一方面，技术进步使这些机器人更加智能和便利。
然而，人们仍可能担心安全、隐私和价格，而这些因素会直接影响他们使用此类产品的意愿。

sentences.text: The popularity of elderly-care robots has several reasons.
sentences.chinesePrompt: 养老机器人受到欢迎有几个原因。

sentences.text: On the one hand, population aging has increased the demand for elderly care, and robots can help relieve the pressure on families and society.
sentences.chinesePrompt: 一方面，人口老龄化增加了养老需求，机器人能够帮助减轻家庭和社会的压力。

sentences.text: On the other hand, advances in technology have made these robots more intelligent and convenient.
sentences.chinesePrompt: 另一方面，技术进步使这些机器人更加智能和便利。

sentences.text: However, people may still worry about safety, privacy, and price, which directly influence their willingness to use such products.
sentences.chinesePrompt: 然而，人们仍可能担心安全、隐私和价格，而这些因素会直接影响他们使用此类产品的意愿。

paragraphs.label: 第3段
outline: 在我看来，制造商应提高产品质量，并更加重视安全和隐私保护。
政府也应制定明确的标准并提供适当支持。
消费者应理性认识这些产品，而不是盲目拒绝或接受。
只有制造商、政府和消费者共同努力，养老机器人才能在社会中发挥更大的作用。

sentences.text: In my opinion, manufacturers should improve product quality and pay more attention to safety and privacy protection.
sentences.chinesePrompt: 在我看来，制造商应提高产品质量，并更加重视安全和隐私保护。
sentences.note: 虽然有`improve`和`pay attention to`两个动作，但共用一个主语`manufacturers`，所以仍然是简单句。

sentences.text: The government should also establish clear standards and provide proper support.
sentences.chinesePrompt: 政府也应制定明确的标准并提供适当支持。

sentences.text: Consumers should understand these products rationally instead of rejecting or accepting them blindly.
sentences.chinesePrompt: 消费者应理性认识这些产品，而不是盲目拒绝或接受。

sentences.text: Only when manufacturers, the government, and consumers work together can elderly-care robots play a greater role in society.
sentences.chinesePrompt: 只有制造商、政府和消费者共同努力，养老机器人才能在社会中发挥更大的作用。

essays.title: 家用电器拥有量变化

paragraphs.label: 第1段
outline: 如图表所示，2014年至2023年三类家用电器的拥有量均有所增加。
2014年，每百户拥有的空调、洗衣机和冰箱数量分别为75.2、83.7和85.5。
空调拥有量增长最快。
总体而言，三类家用电器都呈上升趋势，这反映了人们生活条件的改善。

sentences.text: As is shown in the chart, the ownership of three types of household appliances increased from 2014 to 2023.
sentences.chinesePrompt: 如图表所示，2014年至2023年三类家用电器的拥有量均有所增加。

sentences.text: In 2014, the numbers of air conditioners, washing machines, and refrigerators owned per one hundred households were 75.2, 83.7, and 85.5 respectively.
sentences.chinesePrompt: 2014年，每百户拥有的空调、洗衣机和冰箱数量分别为75.2、83.7和85.5。

sentences.text: By 2023, these figures had increased to 145.9, 98.2, and 103.4 respectively.
The ownership of air conditioners increased the fastest.
sentences.chinesePrompt: 空调拥有量增长最快。

sentences.text: Overall, all three types of household appliances showed an upward trend, which reflects an improvement in people’s living conditions.
sentences.chinesePrompt: 总体而言，三类家用电器都呈上升趋势，这反映了人们生活条件的改善。

paragraphs.label: 第2段
outline: 这一变化主要由生活水平和消费能力的提高造成。
随着收入提高，更多家庭能够购买家用电器，并更加关注舒适度和使用体验。
洗衣机和冰箱增长较慢，因为这些产品已在许多家庭中广泛使用。
相比之下，空调需求仍在持续增长。

sentences.text: This change is mainly caused by improvements in living standards and consumer purchasing power.
sentences.chinesePrompt: 这一变化主要由生活水平和消费能力的提高造成。

sentences.text: As people’s incomes rise, more families can afford household appliances and pay greater attention to comfort and user experience.
sentences.chinesePrompt: 随着收入提高，更多家庭能够购买家用电器，并更加关注舒适度和使用体验。

sentences.text: The growth rates of washing machines and refrigerators are relatively slow because these products are already widely used in many households.
sentences.chinesePrompt: 洗衣机和冰箱增长较慢，因为这些产品已在许多家庭中广泛使用。

sentences.text: By contrast, the demand for air conditioners has continued to grow.
sentences.chinesePrompt: 相比之下，空调需求仍在持续增长。

paragraphs.label: 第3段
outline: 在我看来，制造商应提高产品质量，并开发节能、环保和智能的产品。
政府可以提供适当补贴并完善相关政策。
消费者应根据实际需要理性选择产品。
只有制造商、政府和消费者共同努力，家用电器才能给人们的生活带来更大便利。

sentences.text: In my opinion, manufacturers should improve product quality and develop energy-saving, environmentally friendly, and intelligent products.
sentences.chinesePrompt: 在我看来，制造商应提高产品质量，并开发节能、环保和智能的产品。

sentences.text: The government can provide appropriate subsidies and improve relevant policies.
sentences.chinesePrompt: 政府可以提供适当补贴并完善相关政策。

sentences.text: Consumers should choose products rationally according to their actual needs.
sentences.chinesePrompt: 消费者应根据实际需要理性选择产品。

sentences.text: Only when manufacturers, the government, and consumers work together can household appliances bring greater convenience to people’s lives.

essays.title: 城市公园

paragraphs.label: 第1段
outline: 如图所示，几位居民正在一座新建公园里休息和锻炼。
一个男孩说，他家附近的新公园非常好。
图表显示，该市公园数量从2020年至2022年持续增加。
总体而言，公园数量显著增加，居民也能更方便地享受公共绿色空间。

sentences.text: As is shown in the picture, several residents are resting and exercising in a newly built park.
sentences.chinesePrompt: 如图所示，几位居民正在一座新建公园里休息和锻炼。

sentences.text: A boy says that the new park near his home is very good.
sentences.chinesePrompt: 一个男孩说，他家附近的新公园非常好。

sentences.text: The chart shows that the number of parks in the city increased continuously from 2020 to 2022.
sentences.chinesePrompt: 图表显示，该市公园数量从2020年至2022年持续增加。

sentences.text: There were 406 parks in 2020, 532 in 2021, and 670 in 2022.
Overall, the number of parks increased significantly, and residents can enjoy public green spaces more conveniently.
sentences.chinesePrompt: 总体而言，公园数量显著增加，居民也能更方便地享受公共绿色空间。

paragraphs.label: 第2段
outline: 总体而言，图画和图表反映了城市公共服务和生活环境正在不断改善。
一方面，更多公园能够为居民提供锻炼、散步和休息的场所，并改善身体健康和生活质量。
另一方面，公园是交流和放松的重要空间，能够使城市生活更加舒适。
此外，公园数量增加说明政府越来越重视居民的实际需要。
因此，这一变化不仅改善了城市环境，也增强了居民的幸福感。

sentences.text: In general, the picture and the chart reflect that urban public services and living environments are continuously improving.
sentences.chinesePrompt: 总体而言，图画和图表反映了城市公共服务和生活环境正在不断改善。

sentences.text: On the one hand, more parks can provide residents with places for exercise, walking, and rest and improve their physical health and quality of life.
sentences.chinesePrompt: 一方面，更多公园能够为居民提供锻炼、散步和休息的场所，并改善身体健康和生活质量。
sentences.note: 虽然有两个动作`provide`和`improve`，但共用一个主语`more parks`，仍是简单句。

sentences.text: On the other hand, parks are important spaces for communication and relaxation, and they can make urban life more comfortable.
sentences.chinesePrompt: 另一方面，公园是交流和放松的重要空间，能够使城市生活更加舒适。

sentences.text: In addition, the increase in the number of parks shows that the government is paying greater attention to residents’ actual needs.
sentences.chinesePrompt: 此外，公园数量增加说明政府越来越重视居民的实际需要。

sentences.text: Therefore, this change not only improves the urban environment but also increases residents’ sense of happiness.
sentences.chinesePrompt: 因此，这一变化不仅改善了城市环境，也增强了居民的幸福感。
sentences.note: `not only...but also...`连接两个谓语，不是从句。

paragraphs.label: 第3段
outline: 在我看来，政府应继续合理建设公园，尤其是居民区附近的小型公园。
同时，有关部门应加强日常管理、保持环境清洁并确保公共设施安全。
居民也应保护植物和公共设施，并合理使用公园。
只有政府和居民共同努力，城市公园才能发挥更大的作用，并给个人、家庭和社会带来更多益处。

sentences.text: At the same time, relevant departments should strengthen daily management, keep the environment clean, and ensure the safety of public facilities.

sentences.text: Residents should also protect plants and public facilities and use parks properly.

sentences.text: Only when the government and residents work together can urban parks play a greater role and bring more benefits to individuals, families, and society.

essays.title: 校园讲座

paragraphs.label: 第1段
outline: 如图生动展示的那样，两名学生正站在一张名为“校园讲座”的通知前。
一名学生认为讲座与自己的专业无关，所以没有必要听；另一名学生认为讲座对自己有益，因此需要听。
总体而言，这幅图告诉我们，学生面对专业之外的知识时持有不同态度。
此外，拓宽视野具有重要意义。

sentences.text: As is vividly displayed in the picture, the picture shows that two students are standing in front of a notice named “Campus Lecture.”
sentences.chinesePrompt: 如图生动展示的那样，两名学生正站在一张名为“校园讲座”的通知前。

sentences.text: One student thinks, “The lecture is not related to my major, so I do not need to listen to it,” while another student thinks, “I need to listen to it because it is beneficial to me.”
sentences.chinesePrompt: 一名学生认为讲座与自己的专业无关，所以没有必要听；另一名学生认为讲座对自己有益，因此需要听。
sentences.note:
这句话中包含：
* `while`连接两个学生的不同观点；
* `because`引导原因从句。

sentences.text: In general, the picture tells us that students have different attitudes when facing knowledge outside their majors.
sentences.chinesePrompt: 总体而言，这幅图告诉我们，学生面对专业之外的知识时持有不同态度。

sentences.text: In addition, it is significant that we broaden our horizons.
sentences.chinesePrompt: 此外，拓宽视野具有重要意义。

paragraphs.label: 第2段
outline: 综合考虑，参加不同领域的讲座具有重要意义。
一方面，学生不仅要学习本专业知识，也要了解其他领域的内容。
拓宽视野并丰富知识是有益的。
另一方面，不同学科之间存在联系。
当学生接触新知识时，产生新想法并提高解决问题的能力是有益的。
此外，校园讲座还为学生与教师及其他学生交流提供了机会。
因此，学生不应只关注一场讲座是否对自己的专业有益。
他们应以积极、开放的态度对待新知识。

sentences.text: On the one hand, students not only need to study knowledge in their majors but also need to know about content in other fields.

sentences.note:
`not only...but also...`连接两个谓语：
> need to study
> need to know
所以仍是简单句。

sentences.text: It is beneficial to broaden our horizons and enrich our knowledge.
sentences.chinesePrompt: 拓宽视野并丰富知识是有益的。

sentences.text: On the other hand, different subjects have relationships with each other.
sentences.chinesePrompt: 另一方面，不同学科之间存在联系。

sentences.text: It is beneficial that students create new ideas and improve their ability to solve problems when they come into contact with new knowledge.
sentences.chinesePrompt: 当学生接触新知识时，产生新想法并提高解决问题的能力是有益的。

这句话有两个从句：
> that students create...
> when they come into contact...

sentences.text: What’s more, campus lectures also provide students with chances for communication with teachers and other students.

patterns.structure: As is shown in the chart/picture, ...
patterns.meaning: 第一段开头：描述图表或图画
examples: As is shown in the chart, the ownership of three types of household appliances increased from 2014 to 2023.
As is shown in the picture, several residents are resting and exercising in a newly built park.

patterns.structure: The chart shows that + 完整句子
patterns.meaning: 说明图表呈现的数据变化
examples: The chart shows that the number of parks in the city increased continuously from 2020 to 2022.

patterns.meaning: 概括图表趋势、图画寓意或段落观点
examples: Overall, all three types of household appliances showed an upward trend, which reflects an improvement in people’s living conditions.
In general, this picture shows that traditional customs are becoming more and more popular.

patterns.structure: On the one hand, ... On the other hand, ...
patterns.meaning: 从两个方面分析原因、影响或意义
examples: On the one hand, population aging has increased the demand for elderly care.
On the other hand, advances in technology have made these robots more intelligent and convenient.

patterns.structure: It is beneficial to do A and do B.
examples: It is beneficial to broaden our horizons and enrich our knowledge.

patterns.structure: It is significant that + 完整句子
patterns.meaning: 强调某种现象或行为的重要意义
patterns.position: 第一段总结或第二段总起
examples: In general, it is significant that the dragon boat race has become more popular.
All things considered, it is significant that we take part in lectures in different fields.

patterns.structure: A not only does B but also does C.
patterns.meaning: 并列说明两种作用或结果
examples: This change not only improves the urban environment but also increases residents’ sense of happiness.
The activity of traditional customs not only enriches people’s lives but also promotes the development of traditional culture.

patterns.meaning: 补充说明前面的情况或结果
patterns.position: 第一段总结或第二段分析
examples: People may still worry about safety, privacy, and price, which directly influence their willingness to use such products.

patterns.structure: whether + 完整句子 + or not
examples: Students should not just pay attention to whether a lecture is beneficial to their majors or not.

patterns.structure: Only when + 完整句子 + can + 主语 + 动词原形
patterns.meaning: 第三段结尾：强调共同努力或必要条件

patterns.structure: 主语 + can + 动词 ... only when + 完整句子
